lines.text: Many learners say: Can you give me an advice?
Better: Can you give me some advice?
Advice has no a and no s.

data.wrong: Can you give me an advice?
data.right: Can you give me some advice?
data.why: Advice has no a and no s.

native.tip: advice 是不可数名词，不能加 a/an，也不加 s。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Can you give me an advice?”？😅 advice 不可数，不加 a/an，也不加 s：“Can you give me some advice?”。跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。

en.tip: Advice is uncountable: no a, no an, no s.
en.caption: Do you say “Can you give me an advice?”? 😅 Advice is uncountable, so no a, an or s: “Can you give me some advice?”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
